name: JTBD3 — Inactive users, tightened 30-day window
description: Threshold-variation of the inactive-users JTBD. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model tightens the inactivity window to 30 days; either query-admin-insights (ts-users, Days Since Last Login >= 30) or list-users (lastLogin:lt:<30d-ago>) is acceptable. Read-only.
prompt: Tighten the inactivity window — which users are inactive past 30 days? Report them and state the threshold and field you filtered on. Do not modify anything.
